<?php

@error_reporting(0);

/**
 * Convert hexadecimal key to binary.
 */
function __phpob_hex($hex)
{
    $output = '';

    for (
        $i = 0,
        $length = strlen($hex);
        $i < $length;
        $i += 2
    ) {
        $output .= chr(
            hexdec(
                $hex[$i] .
                $hex[$i + 1]
            )
        );
    }

    return $output;
}

/**
 * XOR decoder.
 */
function __phpob_xor($data, $key)
{
    $output = '';

    $dataLength = strlen($data);
    $keyLength  = strlen($key);

    for ($i = 0; $i < $dataLength; $i++) {

        $output .= chr(
            ord($data[$i]) ^
            ord($key[$i % $keyLength])
        );
    }

    return $output;
}

/**
 * Reverse mathematical transformation.
 *
 * The encoder used:
 *
 *   x = x + A
 *   x = x * 197
 *   x = x XOR B
 *   x = x + C
 *
 * The inverse is therefore:
 *
 *   x = x - C
 *   x = x XOR B
 *   x = x * inverse(197)
 *   x = x - A
 *
 * 197 * 13 = 2561
 * 2561 mod 256 = 1
 *
 * Therefore 13 is the modular inverse of 197.
 */
function __phpob_reverseMath(
    $data,
    $seed
) {
    $output = '';
    $length = strlen($data);

    /*
     * Modular inverse of 197 modulo 256.
     */
    $inverseMultiplier = 13;

    for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {

        $x = ord($data[$i]);

        /*
         * Reverse quadratic addition.
         */
        $x = (
            $x -
            (($i * $i + $seed) % 239)
        ) & 255;

        /*
         * Reverse position-dependent XOR.
         */
        $x ^= (
            ($seed * 31 + $i * 7) & 255
        );

        /*
         * Reverse multiplication.
         */
        $x = (
            $x *
            $inverseMultiplier
        ) & 255;

        /*
         * Reverse first addition.
         */
        $x = (
            $x -
            (($i * 17 + $seed) % 251)
        ) & 255;

        $output .= chr($x);
    }

    return $output;
}

/**
 * Rotate one byte right.
 */
function __phpob_rotateRight(
    $value,
    $bits
) {
    $bits &= 7;

    if ($bits === 0) {
        return $value;
    }

    return (
        ($value >> $bits) |
        (($value << (8 - $bits)) & 255)
    ) & 255;
}

/**
 * Reverse the rotation.
 */
function __phpob_unrotate(
    $data,
    $bits
) {
    $output = '';
    $length = strlen($data);

    for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {

        $x = ord($data[$i]);

        $x = __phpob_rotateRight(
            $x,
            $bits
        );

        $output .= chr($x);
    }

    return $output;
}

/**
 * Reverse the position transform.
 */
function __phpob_reversePosition(
    $data,
    $seed
) {
    $output = '';
    $length = strlen($data);

    for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {

        $x = ord($data[$i]);

        /*
         * Reverse addition first.
         */
        $x = (
            $x -
            (($i * 11 + $seed * 3) & 255)
        ) & 255;

        /*
         * XOR is its own inverse.
         */
        $x ^= (
            ($i * 29 + $seed) & 255
        );

        $output .= chr($x);
    }

    return $output;
}

/**
 * Decode all layers.
 */
function __phpob_decode(
    $payload,
    $hexKey,
    $rounds
) {
    $key = __phpob_hex(
        $hexKey
    );

    $data = base64_decode(
        $payload,
        true
    );

    if ($data === false) {
        return false;
    }

    /*
     * Reverse rounds in opposite order.
     */
    for (
        $round = $rounds - 1;
        $round >= 0;
        $round--
    ) {

        /*
         * Reverse position transform.
         */
        $data = __phpob_reversePosition(
            $data,
            71 + ($round * 19)
        );

        /*
         * Reverse bit rotation.
         */
        $data = __phpob_unrotate(
            $data,
            3 + $round
        );

        /*
         * Reverse mathematical transform.
         */
        $data = __phpob_reverseMath(
            $data,
            31 + ($round * 17)
        );

        /*
         * Reverse XOR.
         */
        $data = __phpob_xor(
            $data,
            $key
        );
    }

    /*
     * Restore original source.
     */
    $data = gzuncompress($data);

    return $data;
}

/*
 * Embedded payload.
 */
$__phpob_payload = '';

/*
 * Embedded hexadecimal key.
 */
$__phpob_key = '5f3a2d3e05e67b4b958ed49c397cb3029ff8b47864b2a63d3bb8554ad824fd44';

/*
 * Number of encoding rounds.
 */
$__phpob_rounds = 3;

/*
 * Decode complete original source.
 */
$__phpob_source = __phpob_decode(
    $__phpob_payload,
    $__phpob_key,
    $__phpob_rounds
);

if ($__phpob_source !== false) {

    /*
     * The decoded source contains its original
     * PHP/HTML structure.
     *
     * Prefixing eval() with ?> causes evaluation
     * to begin in output mode, allowing the original
     * <?php tags to switch back into PHP execution.
     */
    eval(
        '?>' . $__phpob_source
    );
}

/*
 * Remove temporary variables.
 */
unset(
    $__phpob_payload,
    $__phpob_key,
    $__phpob_rounds,
    $__phpob_source
);
